label: Standard deduction or itemized deductions
description: Form 1040 Line 12e standard deduction or itemized deductions (successor to line 12; guards the itemized side to the derived Schedule A composition whenever a Form 1098 statement is on record).

published_value.explain: Form 1040 line 12e is the larger of the standard deduction and the itemized deductions.

computed_zero.explain: Form 1040 line 12e (Standard deduction or itemized deductions) is zero because the calculation comes to zero.

closure_backed_zero.explain: Form 1040 line 12e (Standard deduction or itemized deductions) is zero because nothing was recorded and that record is complete.

blocked.explain: Form 1040 line 12e has no value yet. It is waiting for the standard deduction or the itemized deductions.

guard_inapplicable.explain: Form 1040 line 12e (Standard deduction or itemized deductions) shows no value because its condition does not hold.
